reviews.text: Nhiều người biết đến với những món ăn lạ

Ngon
Vệ sinh và an toàn

Tôi không phải là người quá thích đồ ăn chay nhưng chắc chắn tôi sẽ quay lại đây. Bánh mì kẹp rau củ rất ngon và đậm đà hương vị. Nước ép dưa hấu tươi ngon ngay cả khi không thêm đường. Mọi thứ đều được làm theo yêu cầu nên hãy kiên nhẫn với nhân viên nhé. Tôi rất thích trải nghiệm ở đây :)

Great place to stay, family run guesthouse, English available. I stayed at this guest house when they were first setting up and joining the AirBnB community (July 2017)  Details/photos on the set up/room/laundry/bathrooms are there.  It was clean, near the airport, walking distance to catch a bus, taxi to other local interests. Next to a couple eating/hang out places only a bit of noise Fri/Sat evening.  My room was right on the street.  Located above (stair access) a vegan restaurant (the family own two) that supports their social enterprises.  The food was fresh and flavorful and you'll meet locals just eating there. The neighborhood is safe for long evening walks or going to local markets.  People travel from nearby to find the restaurant which I think is on HappyCow. Family is eager to assure you have a nice stay.  It is a nice feeling that you are supporting a greater good during your visit and want to hug them all when you leave.  They have a web page that explains it all. I would certainly stay here again.
